review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent expectation for the frozen pending-decision case. REQ-001, AC-001–AC-003, DEC-001, repository identity, base commit, and paired-case identity agree with the original specification. DEC-001 materially affects rejection semantics and remains explicitly unresolved; the recommended-option acceptance criteria are conditional, not authorization to select OPT-1. Therefore blocked readiness, the requirement-decision-pending reason scoped to DEC-001, evidence through repository/requirements/decisions, and empty task and assignment expectations are appropriate. Later Scenario Coverage reviewer and assignment-capability prerequisites do not supersede this earlier deterministic decision block. The supplied source supports index.js and index.d.ts as implementation and public-contract owners, with test.js and index.test-d.ts as verification scope and package.json defining xo && ava && tsd. Forwarded clearQueue references do not require separate implementation edits, and no declaration-generation evidence displaces index.d.ts ownership. The release fingerprints and model, policy, sampling, and budget fields agree between Gold and preview. The supplied provenance explains the distinct manifest/evaluation digest domains and trimmed/untrimmed PRD fingerprints. Historical project reuse does not itself compromise independence: the supplied isolation facts state that this Gold precedes every candidate on this bundle and no historical candidate outputs are supplied. This approval concerns the benchmark expectation only, not a human decision, execution result, assignment, or release authorization. I relied on the Service-supplied mechanical digest bindings; I did not recompute hashes or execute code.
